messages.text: At home power the sats usually come to less than the electricity — that's not why people buy it. You buy it for the shot at a full block, 3.125 BTC, drawn every ten minutes for years, plus steady sats to your own wallet meanwhile. At 650 W the 40T runs about $34 a month at 10¢. What do you pay per kWh?

Quick correction on my number: at 650 W it's about 468 kWh a month, so roughly $47 at 10¢, not $34 — my mistake.

For that you get 40 TH/s drawing on every block, sats to your own wallet daily, and a real node-grade machine to learn on. Best value per TH we sell. Want me to build the cart? Ships November 21, 2026.
